audience: Originating Sailor/LPO and five reviewing roles evaluating fictional CASREPs; a visible actor selector simulates identity.
primaryTask: Write and validate a synthetic CASREP, save, submit, inspect return feedback, revise, obtain all current-revision reviews and explicitly mock-release.
successOutcome: RELEASED, holder NONE, two immutable revisions and five valid approvals; downloadable synthetic message/audit package matches the saved release.

screens.name: CASREP workspace
screens.purpose: Report list, message authoring/preview, current holder and six-stage route, visible local save state; expose review actions beside current content.
screens.primaryAction: Save draft, then Submit; downstream Approve and forward; CO Approve then Mock release

screens.name: Version and conflict review
screens.purpose: Inspect old/new field values, comments, both branches and approval validity before explicitly selecting a merged repair value.

screens.name: Guide and fielding brief
screens.purpose: Live walkthrough, full permission table, data provenance, source link, classification and integration boundary and fielding prerequisites.

states.empty: Explain synthetic local workspace and offer Start INITIAL. Sample type loader offers all four exact supplied messages; replacing a dirty editor requires Save or Discard.
states.loading: Disable duplicate action while API request/atomic save is pending, announce Saving or Reviewing; no Saved indicator before acknowledgement.
states.error: Show precise field/role/storage error inline and in live status; preserve editable text, durable snapshot and audit. Release blocked with reason and next actor. Conflict view presents competing values with explicit selection.
states.success: Confirm Saved revision or next holder; route status and count update after commit. Mock release explicitly says no transmission. Display synthetic disclaimer on every screen and export.

persistence: Service journal survives reload/restart outside deployment manifest. Browser local draft buffer preserves unfinished text; mark Unsaved changes separately. Switching actor, sample or report cannot approve different saved content while dirty: deliberate Save or Discard. Export only durable snapshot. Reset requires confirmation and never silently overwrites other reports.
recovery: Correct invalid message then retry. Labeled local fault selector exercises failed save/export and recovery. Conflict sample is explicit scenario setup, not a successful release; compare fields, choose/edit resolution, save with both parents and restart review. Preserve all branches. Local blocked-work notice escalates to current reviewer without sending messages. Stop halts processing; startup never replays release.
keyboard: Native labeled inputs/selects/buttons, logical Tab order, Enter/Space activation, visible focus, errors associated with textarea and polite status region; focus error or next action. Desktop master/detail becomes stacked list/editor at narrow width without page overflow. Tables wrap or scroll locally, route labels remain textual; no color-only status. Restrained system typography and clear primary action hierarchy.
